data.one_liner: Framework for describing and verifying hardware in Dart.
data.what_it_does: ROHD lets you model hardware components, simulate them, and generate SystemVerilog or SystemC code. It includes a fast event‑based simulator, waveform capture, and tooling for IP integration.
use_when: You need a Dart‑based hardware description language
You want to generate SystemVerilog/SystemC from Dart
You want to unit‑test hardware logic in Dart
avoid_when: You are targeting a language other than Dart
You need a full EDA toolchain with vendor support
weaknesses: Not a traditional HDL, limited vendor tool integration
No native support for commercial EDA tools
data.setup_notes: Add rohd to pubspec, run `dart pub get`, optionally install VS Code extension for syntax and viewers.
